transcript.en: Right. Next on the agenda we have traffic and highways. Councillor Thornton.
transcript.zh: 好的。下一个议程的内容是关于交通和公路。有请议员Thornton。

transcript.en: Thank you. Well, we now have the results of the survey carried out last month about traffic and road transport in the town.
transcript.zh: 非常感谢。嗯，上个月进行的关于小镇交通和道路运输的调查我们现在有了结果。

transcript.en: People were generally satisfied with the state of the roads.
transcript.zh: 人们普遍对道路状况感到满意。

transcript.en: There were one or two complaints about potholes which will be addressed,
transcript.zh: 有一两条关于道路坑洼的投诉将得到解决

transcript.en: but a significant number of people complained about the increasing number of heavy vehicles using our local roads to avoid traffic elsewhere.
transcript.zh: 但有相当多的人抱怨说，越来越多的重型车辆为避免其他地方的交通问题而使用我们本地的道路。

transcript.en: We'd expected more complaints by commuters about the reduction in the train service, but it doesn't seem to have affected people too much.
transcript.zh: 我们原以为通勤上班的人会对列车运营服务的减少有更多的抱怨，但这似乎并没有对人们产生太大的影响。

transcript.en: The cycle path that runs alongside the river is very well used by both cyclists and pedestrians since the surface was improved last year,
transcript.zh: 自去年路面改善以来，沿河行驶的自行车道被骑车人和行人很好地利用

transcript.en: but overtaking can be a problem so we're going to add a bit on the side to make it wider.
transcript.zh: 但超车可能是个问题，因此我们将在侧边增加一点，使其更宽

transcript.en: At some stage, we'd like to extend the path so that it goes all the way through the town, but that won't be happening in the immediate future.
transcript.zh: 在未来某个阶段，我们想把这条路延伸遍布到整个城镇，但这项工程可能不会在近期展开。

transcript.en: The plans to have a pedestrian crossing next to the Post Office have unfortunately had to be put on hold for the time being.
transcript.zh: 不幸的是，在邮局旁边修建人行道的计划不得不暂时搁置。

transcript.en: We'd budgeted for this to be done this financial year,
transcript.zh: 我们本已经在本财政年度将这项工程编入预算

transcript.en: but then there were rumours that the Post Office was going to move, which would have meant there wasn't really a need for a crossing.
transcript.zh: 但后来有传言说邮局要搬走，这就意味着根本不需要修建横穿马路的人行道。

transcript.en: Now they've confirmed that they're staying where they are,
transcript.zh: 现在他们已经确认了邮局的位置不变

transcript.en: but the Highways Department have told us that it would be dangerous to have a pedestrian crossing where we'd originally planned it as there's a bend in the road there.
transcript.zh: 但是公路部门告诉我们，在原计划的位置建人行横道是很危险的，因为那里有个转弯。

transcript.en: So that'll need some more thought.
transcript.zh: 因此我们还需要更多的考量。

transcript.en: On Station Road near the station and level crossing, drivers can face quite long waits if the level crossing's closed, and we've now got signs up requesting them not to leave their engines running at that time.
transcript.zh: 在车站和公、铁路交叉道口附近的Station Road上，如果公、铁交叉道口关闭，司机可能会面临比较长的等待时间，我们现在树立起了标识，要求他们在等待期间将发动机引擎关闭。

transcript.en: This means pedestrians waiting on the pavement to cross the railway line don't have to breathe in car fumes.
transcript.zh: 这意味着在人行道上等待通过铁路线的行人不必吸入汽车尾气。

transcript.en: We've had some problems with cyclists leaving their bikes chained to the railings outside the ticket office, but the station has agreed to provide bike racks there
transcript.zh: 我们遇到了一些骑自行车的人把车拴在售票处外的栏杆上的问题，但车站已经同意在那里提供自行车架。

transcript.en: So next on the agenda is 'Proposals for improvements to the recreation ground'.Councillor Thornton again.
transcript.zh: 那么下一项内容是关于改进娱乐场地的提议。再次有请议员Thornton。

transcript.en: Well, since we managed to extend the recreation ground,
transcript.zh: 好的，自从设法扩建了游乐场之后

transcript.en: We've spent some time talking to local people about how it could be made a more attractive and useful space.
transcript.zh: 我们就花了一些时间和当地人讨论如何使它成为一个更有吸引力和更有用的空间。

transcript.en: If you have a look at the map up on the screen, you can see the river up in the north, and the Community Hall near the entrance from the road.
transcript.zh: 如果看一眼屏幕上的地图，大家可以看到北面的河流，以及靠近入口的社区大厅。

transcript.en: At present, cars can park between the Community Hall and that line of trees to the east,
transcript.zh: 目前，汽车可以停在社区大厅和东边那排树之间的位置

transcript.en: but this is quite dangerous for pedestrians so we're suggesting a new car park on the opposite side of the Community Hall, right next to it.
transcript.zh: 但这对行人来说是相当危险的，所以我们提议在社区大厅的另外一侧，就在它旁边建一个新的停车场。

transcript.en: We also have a new location for the cricket pitch.
transcript.zh: 我们还有一个新的板球场地。

transcript.en: As we've now purchased additional space to the east of the recreation ground, beyond the trees,
transcript.zh: 由于我们现在已经购买了游乐场东面，树木外侧的额外土地空间

transcript.en: we plan to move it away from its current location, which is rather near the road, into this new area beyond the line of trees.
transcript.zh: 我们计划将板球场从目前离公路很近的位置，移到树木线外侧的这片新区域。

transcript.en: This means there's less danger of stray balls hitting cars or pedestrians.
transcript.zh: 这意味着偏离板球击中汽车或行人的危险性将会得到降低。

transcript.en: We've got plans for a children's playground which will be accessible  by a footpath from the Community Hall and will be alongside the river.
transcript.zh: 我们计划在河边建一个儿童游乐场，可以从社区大厅通过人行道进入。

transcript.en: We'd originally thought of having it close to the road, but we think this will be a more attractive location.
transcript.zh: 我们最初的打算是想将它安排在公路附近，但我们认为新的安排才是一个更具吸引力的位置。

transcript.en: The skateboard ramp is very popular with both younger and older children - we had considered moving this up towards the river,
transcript.zh: 滑板坡道很受小孩子和大孩子的欢迎——我们曾考虑过把它移到河边

transcript.en: but in the end we decided to have it in the southeast corner near the road.
transcript.zh: 但最后我们决定把它放在靠近公路的东南角

transcript.en: The pavilion is very well used at present by both football players and cricketers.
transcript.zh: 这个场馆目前被足球和板球运动员非常好地利用。

transcript.en: It will stay where it is now - to the left of the line of trees and near to the river- handy for both the football and cricket pitches.
transcript.zh: 它会依然呆在目前的位置——树的左侧，靠近河边——这对足球场和板球场都比较方便。

transcript.en: And finally, we'll be getting a new notice board for local information, and that will be directly on people's right as they go from the road  into the recreation ground.
transcript.zh: 最后，我们会设置一个新的本地信息公告板，当大家从马路上走进游乐场时，它会直接出现人们的右手边。
